list.name: ministry
list.label: Ministère
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT ministry_name AS __text, ministry_id::text AS __value FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE ministry_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ministry_name

list.name: entity
list.label: Entité
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity_code FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE entity_code IS NOT NULL AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) ORDER BY entity_code

list.name: workflow
list.label: Workflow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workflow_code FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE workflow_code IS NOT NULL AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) ORDER BY workflow_code

list.name: method
list.label: Méthode
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT payment_method FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE payment_method IS NOT NULL ORDER BY payment_method

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(effective_city, '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(effective_city, 'unassigned') AS __value FROM v_treasury_payments_by_site WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS total FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring}))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(completed_count), 0) FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring}))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rejected_count), 0) FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring}))

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sla_breached_count), 0) FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring}))

SELECT AVG(avg_processing_minutes)::numeric(10,2) FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring}))

SELECT report_date AS time, SUM(total_amount) AS "Total" FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring})) GROUP BY report_date ORDER BY report_date

SELECT payment_method, SUM(total_amount) AS amount FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring})) GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT entity_name AS "Entité", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total" FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) GROUP BY entity_name ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT workflow_code AS "Workflow", SUM(payment_count) AS "#", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total" FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring})) GROUP BY workflow_code ORDER BY "#" DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT ministry_name AS "Ministère", payment_method AS "Méthode", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total", SUM(payment_count) AS "#" FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND payment_method IN (${method:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (SELECT entity_code FROM v_entity_locations_browse WHERE city IN (${site:sqlstring})) GROUP BY ministry_name, payment_method ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT entity_name AS "Entité", SUM(payment_count) AS "Paiements", SUM(sla_breached_count) AS "SLA breach", SUM(sla_warning_count) AS "SLA warn", (SUM(sla_breached_count) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(payment_count), 0))::numeric(10,2) AS "SLA breach %", AVG(avg_processing_minutes)::numeric(10,1) AS "Durée moy (min)" FROM mv_treasury_daily_kpis WHERE report_date BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND ministry_id::text IN (${ministry:sqlstring}) AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) GROUP BY entity_name ORDER BY "Paiements" DESC

SELECT COALESCE(effective_city, '(unassigned)') AS "Site", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total", COUNT(*) AS "#" FROM v_treasury_payments_by_site WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(effective_city, 'unassigned') IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(entity_code, '?') IN (${entity:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(workflow_code, '?') IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) GROUP BY effective_city ORDER BY "Total" DESC

SELECT COALESCE(effective_city, '(unassigned)') AS "Site", payment_method AS "Méthode", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total" FROM v_treasury_payments_by_site WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(effective_city, 'unassigned') IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(entity_code, '?') IN (${entity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY effective_city, payment_method ORDER BY "Total" DESC

SELECT location_source, count(*) AS n FROM v_treasury_payments_by_site WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(entity_code, '?') IN (${entity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY location_source ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT created_at AS "Date", entity_code AS "Entité", COALESCE(effective_city, '(unassigned)') AS "Site", workflow_code AS "Workflow", payment_method AS "Méthode", payment_status AS "Statut", total_amount AS "Total", location_source AS "Source loc.", channel AS "Canal" FROM v_treasury_payments_by_site WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(effective_city, 'unassigned') IN (${site:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(entity_code, '?') IN (${entity:sqlstring}) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100
